held_position_min_eigenvalue.comparison_conditions: Same protocol, window, normalization, input treatment, operating-point construction, task and model implementation. Changed candidates use their own compiled model.
held_position_min_eigenvalue.definition: Minimum eigenvalue of local finite-horizon position-output controllability Gramian for input held over each control interval
held_position_min_eigenvalue.input_treatment: Unconstrained signed incremental input held per control interval; physical unilateral bounded tensions are reported separately and not fully represented by this scalar
held_position_min_eigenvalue.represented_constraints: Local linear model and held-input sampling only
held_position_min_eigenvalue.supported_interpretation: Local normalized position-output authority; held means held input, not task holding success
